_comment: Hand-edited. Named groups of items the plugin checks for (any id in a group counts). Run scripts/update_item_data.py after editing to regenerate src/main/resources/.../items.json.

descriptions.spade: Harvests crops, digs up tree roots and clears dead plants.
descriptions.seed_dibber: Plants seeds. Not needed after Barbarian Training's seed planting.
descriptions.magic_secateurs: Prunes diseased trees and bushes; +10% yield from herbs, allotments, hops and grapes when carried.
descriptions.gardening_trowel: Fills plant pots with soil and pots seeds to grow saplings.
descriptions.plant_cure: Cures a diseased patch (trees and bushes are pruned with secateurs instead).
descriptions.axe: Chops down a grown tree so you can clear the patch yourself.
descriptions.compost: Halves the chance of disease and adds 1 harvest.
descriptions.supercompost: Cuts the chance of disease by 80% and adds 2 harvests.
descriptions.ultracompost: Cuts the chance of disease by 90% and adds 3 harvests.
descriptions.bottomless_compost_bucket: Holds one type of compost in bulk, so you carry one item instead of many buckets.
descriptions.farmers_strawhat: Farmer's outfit: +0.4% Farming XP (+2.5% with the full set).
descriptions.farmers_jacket: Farmer's outfit: +0.8% Farming XP (+2.5% with the full set).
descriptions.farmers_boro_trousers: Farmer's outfit: +0.6% Farming XP (+2.5% with the full set).
descriptions.farmers_boots: Farmer's outfit: +0.2% Farming XP (+2.5% with the full set).
descriptions.seed_box: Carries up to 6 kinds of seeds in one inventory slot.
descriptions.amulet_of_bounty: Worn while planting allotments: 25% chance to use one seed instead of three (10 charges).
descriptions.coins: Pays gardeners to clear grown trees (200 coins each).
descriptions.house_tablet: Teleports you into your house, for its portals (used up).
descriptions.construction_cape: Unlimited teleports into your house, for its portals.
descriptions.rune_pouch: Holds runes in one inventory slot; they count as carried.
descriptions.herb_sack: Picked herbs go straight in when it's open, so they don't fill your inventory.
